finding.trigger: Cancel a child after it signals readiness and installs a SIGTERM-ignoring handler.
finding.observed: With SIGTERM-only cancellation the child remained active and the future incomplete after 0.3 seconds; manual SIGKILL was needed for the review fixture.
finding.resolution: The revised cancellation path immediately sends SIGKILL to its owned process groups, including late registrations, and original transport cleanup proves quiescence.
